text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
U-ugh, I can't move! I'm totally<n>defenseless
against the powers of<n>evil right now!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Pull yourself together, Biko! Want me<n>to give you a
piggyback ride?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Anything but that! A hero always<n>walks on her own
two feet!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: No matter the crisis... or danger...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! ☆ That was my Japanese and<n>Western
fusion full course meal! ☆<n>I'm so happy you
cleaned every<n>single plate!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
It was a homemade present from<n>you, so of course
I'd finish it! A hero<n>would never leave leftovers!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I almost forgot about the chocolate<n>ice cream
cake I made. It should have<n>cooled down by now,
so let's take it<n>out and dig in!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Th-there's still more?! U-ugh... I<n>won't fall here!
